title: ProvOrganization
description: Rootless shape facet — PROV Organization agent type: "a social or legal institution such as a company, society, etc." One of the three agent types PROV defines for interoperability. PROV defines no attributes specific to Organization. Source: W3C PROV-DM (REC-prov-dm-20130430) §5.3.1 Agent, prov:Organization; PROV-O prov:Organization.

id.description: Identifier for the organization agent — mandatory per PROV-DM §5.7.1; a qualified name, mappable to an IRI (§5.7.5).
